purpose: Provide a root-deployable, cold-reader publication and newsroom entry layer over the Clifford Number evidence backend without duplicating canonical truth.

websiteiq_audit.measured_result: The completed report reached the GitHub Pages account origin, which returned a 404. It did not audit the project page content at /clifford-number/.
websiteiq_audit.contract_finding: WebsiteIQ's API separates the origin URL from landingPath, while the browser-facing flow normalized the submitted path to the origin root.
websiteiq_audit.corrected_result: The origin plus /clifford-number/ landingPath request was structurally valid, but WebsiteIQ enforced the consumed same-day target limit and offered a paid x402 continuation. No second report was issued.
websiteiq_audit.interpretation_boundary: The estate may rely on the measured origin-root failure. It may not claim a WebsiteIQ content score for the project pathname.

reader_routes.function: selection, receipt, temporal, and publication rules
limitations, privacy, correction, and editorial-control contract

publication_contract.what_this_is: A curated public entry layer that exposes bounded questions, evidence limits, counterweights, and open reporting records.
publication_contract.what_this_is_not: A guilt graph, influence score, probability engine, or independently approved publication of every backend record.
standing_refusals: later evidence does not establish earlier knowledge
source failure does not prove absence

required: title, description, canonical, JSON-LD, and semantic landmarks
keyboard skip navigation and visible focus
zero browser console or page errors
